perspective:

- When he asked if she was okay, Patricia told him it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.

- Jose told Patricia he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend, and Patricia said it was good to know she had someone to turn to.
- Later, Jose sensed Patricia preferred to handle her issues privately, so he kept the conversation light by asking about her weekend. Patricia said she was doing fine and planned a quiet weekend at home.
- He continued checking in with her at work. Patricia told him she was busy but handling things, thanked him for checking in, and said it was really great to have his support.
- Jose offered to help with anything, even just getting coffee, and said they were all there to help each other out.
final_response:
